Do you have questions, technical problems, or need help making the most of our generation models?
        Here you will find answers and ways to contact us.
support.listitem3: How do I start using the image and video generators?
support.listitem4: Once you acquire a plan, access your dashboard from the main menu. There you can select the generation model (Veo 3, Image 4.0, Nova Canva, Nova Reel) and start creating your content.
support.listitem5: Can I change my plan at any time?
support.listitem6: Yes, you can change your plan from your account. The new plan is activated immediately and the number of available tokens is adjusted according to your current subscription.
support.listitem7: What do I do if I have problems with content generation?
support.listitem8: If a model does not respond correctly or the generated content does not meet your expectations, please fill out the following form indicating the problem and attach examples if possible.
